Experiência em projetos que envolvam a integração entre sistemas de automação (OT) e sistemas corporativos (IT). description: Department: Events & Entertainment Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. THE POSITION The Ceremonies Manager supports the end to end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments. Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, the Ceremonies Manager supports the planning and operational delivery of all official ceremonies, working closely with the Senior Manager and wider Entertainment team to ensure alignment with FIFA’s vision, brand standards. The role supports and coordinates the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring that all ceremonies are executed in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA. Working closely with the Entertainment Team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Manager supports the Senior Manager in coordinating the operational delivery of ceremonies, contributing to creative and operational review processes and helping ensure the execution of iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Ceremonies Project Leadership Support the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA. Support the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament. Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through pre-production, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover. Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams. Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables. Provide senior decision making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation. Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC. Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into match day and event day operations. Escalate ceremony related operational matters. Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy. Team Leadership Support the Ceremonies Team by contributing to day-to-day coordination, operational readiness, and delivery standards. Assist with the onboarding and support of Ceremonies personnel—suppliers, freelancers, and event-time workforce—helping ensure consistent standards and operational preparedness. Contribute to internal talent development through daily guidance, structured feedback, and knowledge sharing. Support effective collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units. Contribute to coordination between venue-based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution. Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonies workstreams. Major Ceremonies Oversight Support the planning and delivery processes for all major ceremonial events, including Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament. Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management Support the development and refinement of the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony in collaboration with the Entertainment Team. Contribute to the integration of host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful manner. Assist in the creation of creative briefs, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows in coordination with internal teams and external agencies. Contribute to stakeholder approval processes to ensure all content is delivered, documented, and archived in line with operational requirements. Support IP and copyright compliance across all ceremony-related content. Planning Scheduling & Documentation Maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams. Ensure operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled. Coordinate with multiple suppliers and conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting. Prepare written and oral presentations, high-level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts. Organize and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings. Support the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams. Contribute to ensuring readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and provide operational support on event days. Support operational decision-making to help maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Assist with rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies. Support venue level preproduction activities, including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning. Supplier & Budget Management Support procurement processes as directed by the Ceremonies Senior Manager, including supplier briefing and evaluation. Manage day-to-day relationships with entertainment suppliers and contractors at assigned venue(s). Assist with budget management tasks, including forecasting inputs, cost tracking, variation documentation, and invoice processing, ensuring accuracy and timely follow-up. Help monitor contractual deliverables and timelines, ensuring they remain aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements, and escalute risks to the Senior Manager as needed. Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison Act as a liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE, in coordination with the Senior Manager. Deliver concise briefings and alignment updates across all internal and external stakeholders. Support the building and maintenance of relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies. Ensure early phase cross functional integration to support seamless operational delivery. Venue Readiness & Execution Support preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns. Direct venue level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning. Contribute to ensuring readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and support execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Assist in rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination. Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre-event testing and rehearsal phases. Other Duties Perform additional responsibilities as required by management aligned with project delivery. Represent the Ceremonies function in cross-functional planning forums and management briefings. Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament‑wide entertainment integration. YOUR PROFILE Education Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience. Experience 5+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events. Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations. Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross-functional coordination. Experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi-supplier contracts and budgets. Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies. Skills & Competencies ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately. ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high-pressure environments. FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period. COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level. ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines. PROBLEM-SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem-solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLABORATION: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals. INTERPERSONAL SKILLS: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross-functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment. CULTURAL SENSITIVITY: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant. PASSION FOR ENTERTAINMENT: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire. Certifications & Requirements Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools. Experience of Monday.com an advantage. Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus. The right to work in Brazil. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Descrição da vaga Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços. Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay. Desafios estratégicos O mercado de mídia e entretenimento vive numa constante transformação, com variadas formas, comportamentos, plataformas e monetização do consumo de conteúdo. Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo. Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio. Para suportar tanta transformação, precisamos entender os movimentos da indústria, o mercado cliente, a nossa estratégia de negócio, as tendências de tecnologia, nossas alavancas e nossos gaps. Projetar novas capacidades de tecnologia, transformar algumas e, buscar inovação e parcerias, se faz absolutamente necessário. Atuação de Arquitetura A Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo, busca profissionais que possam trabalhar na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e a execução. A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa. Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio. A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA. Traga sua experiência em benchmarks da indústria, mapas de capacidades, arquiteturas de referência, análises de gaps e buy or build e, construção de visões de futuro e roadmaps de tecnologia. O que a área te oferece de oportunidade Vai conduzir trabalhos de grande visibilidade que influenciam decisões estratégicas de tecnologia Você vai ter um conhecimento amplo da empresa e da indústria de mídia Vai desenvolver um olhar transversal e estratégico entre as capacidades de negócio e tecnológicas de toda a empresa Posição de Arquitetura de Dados & IA Esta posição irá ajudar a evoluir a arquitetura fundacional de dados & IA da Globo, que habilita os workloads de analytics, machine learning, generative AI e agentic AI. Diversidade Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação. Ponto de atenção Os resultados imediatos do trabalho desta posição são decisões que vão influenciar a esteira de execução. Portanto, diferentemente de uma área de delivery de software ou operação, as mudanças são sentidas no médio e longo prazo. Requisitos e qualificações Do que você precisa Vivência com arquitetura fundacional de dados & IA , que habilita os workloads de analytics, machine learning, generative AI e agentic AI para diferentes necessidades de negócio; Inglês avançado/nativo; Formação superior; Especializações na área Dados & AI. Conhecimentos que te destacam Atuação prévia em arquitetura de soluções ou arquitetura corporativa; Conhecimento do stack de dados & IA do Google; Capacidade de entender e comunicar desafios complexos com clareza, estruturando mensagens de forma objetiva e adaptada a diferentes públicos. title: Production Control Engineer
description: The Production Control Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and traceability of production data, acting as the technical authority for hydrocarbon accounting, allocation, reconciliation, and reporting across offshore facilities. Working closely with metering, subsurface, finance, and commercial teams, the role will guarantee reliable calculation and reporting of oil, gas, water, and associated fluids, while driving continuous improvement of accounting systems, data quality, and best practice. Responsibilities Ensure accurate hydrocarbon accounting for oil, gas, water, and associated fluids, including production allocation, reconciliation, inventory management, ullage calculations, and custody transfer, as well as injection, waste, and emissions, performed within internal and industry standards with due diligence, analysis, and data validation. Perform, validate, and approve daily, monthly, and annual production reconciliations between metering systems, tank inventories, export measurements, and allocation calculations prior to regulatory and internal reporting. Maintain the integrity and reliability of production accounting data, systems, and processes, ensuring full traceability and auditability of all reported figures. Participate in operational reviews and provide production accounting input to support operational decision making. Act as the technical focal point for production control and hydrocarbon accounting matters within the organization. Support regulatory audits, inspections, and data requests related to production and other fluids accounting. Prepare, validate, and submit mandatory monthly and annual production reports to the Brazilian regulatory authority (ANP). Support the implementation and maintenance of production accounting tools and data analytics platforms. Promote automation and digitalization initiatives related to production data management and reporting. Education Bachelor's Degree in any field of Engineering Experience Experience in this position in the Oil and Gas industry. Knowledge Familiar with metering regulation and best industry standards such as ANP, RTM, API, SOX Experience in hydrocarbon accounting and production data management Good understanding and knowledge of FPSO marine & process systems Knowledge of programming languages such as Python, SQL Knowledge in Hydrocarbon Accounting Tools (such as Energy Components, EnergySys, PDM) #J-18808-Ljbffr

Responsabilidades e atribuições Apoiar a execução de manutenções preventivas e corretivas em linhas de transmissão, conforme procedimentos, instruções de trabalho e orientação do eletricista líder/encarregado da atividade. Auxiliar inspeções de rotina em estruturas, acessórios e componentes da linha e da faixa de servidão, registrando condições observadas e evidências conforme padrão adotado. Apoiar atividades de manejo de vegetação relacionadas à manutenção da linha e acessos (roçada, poda e corte), conforme procedimentos e orientação da liderança. Auxiliar atividades de manutenção em campo, incluindo preparação da frente de trabalho, organização do local, isolamento e sinalização, e recomposição/limpeza da área após a execução. Apoiar atividades de manutenção em estruturas e componentes de linha, atuando em altura quando requerido, sempre sob orientação e conforme requisitos de segurança aplicáveis. Manusear ferramentas manuais e elétricas e equipamentos de apoio à manutenção, zelando pela conservação, organização e uso adequado. Apoiar atividades de mobilização e logística de campo, incluindo carregamento/descarregamento e organização de materiais, ferramentas e equipamentos necessários às frentes de serviço. Apoiar medições e verificações de campo relacionadas às rotinas de manutenção/inspeção (quando aplicável e autorizado), registrando resultados e evidências conforme procedimentos. Atuar como apoio ao Técnico de Manutenção da localidade em atividades em subestações, compondo equipe para atendimento a requisitos de segurança e execução, sob orientação do técnico responsável pela atividade. Permanecer de sobreaviso quando escalado e atuar no atendimento de ocorrências e manobras associadas às intervenções, sob coordenação do Centro de Operação e liderança local. Registrar apontamentos, checklists, fotos e informações de execução no sistema corporativo de gestão de manutenção, conforme padrões de rastreabilidade definidos. Reportar anomalias, desvios e necessidades de intervenção ao eletricista líder/encarregado e à supervisão, contribuindo para priorização e encaminhamento. Apoiar a conservação e a manutenção básica das instalações e infraestrutura de apoio (predial/civil leve), conforme diretrizes locais. Cumprir rigorosamente normas, procedimentos e requisitos de segurança (incluindo NR-10, NR-35 e regras locais), interrompendo atividades e comunicando a liderança quando identificar condição insegura. Conduzir veículos da empresa, zelando pela utilização correta, conservação e segurança, bem como pelo adequado uso e preservação de EPI’s, EPC’s, ferramentas e instrumentos de trabalho. Requisitos e qualificações Requisitos Ensino médio completo. Formação profissional/qualificação na área elétrica (ex.: Eletricista de Manutenção, Eletricista de Linhas ou equivalente). Aptidão para atividades em campo, incluindo condições para atuação em trabalho em altura quando requerido. CNH categoria B. Requisitos Desejáveis Vivência inicial em manutenção/inspeção de linhas de transmissão ou distribuição. Noções de leitura e interpretação de desenhos/arranjos e procedimentos de campo. title: Analista de Suporte Pleno
description: Contexto O Tech Stop é o balcão de TI e experiência workplace nos hubs da empresa, com foco em alta disponibilidade (modelo com mínimo de dois analistas nos hubs principais para cobrir pausas e continuidade), integração com fila presencial e tickets (Jira Service Management), incluindo fluxos de autoatendimento (ex.: kiosk) que criam e enriquecem chamados sem substituir o atendimento humano. No desenho do TechCenter em Packs, este papel está no Pack 3 — TechStop / Workplace: atendimento presencial e ambiente físico de trabalho, com interface aos Packs de dados e backlog, modelo de filas e atendimento (Pack 5), onboarding presencial (Pack 4) e escalonamento técnico quando o caso sai do escopo imediato de balcão/L1 (Pack 2 — Engineering Interface / L2). Missão Garantir primeira intervenção humana de qualidade nos chamados de nível 1 e no balcão Tech Stop, com triagem correta, boa experiência do colaborador no hub e cumprimento de SLAs, sabendo quando escalar para times especializados ou L2. Principais responsabilidades Atendimento presencial (Tech Stop): fila no balcão, chamadas ordenadas, registro e encerramento adequados no ticket, comunicação clara com o solicitante. Atendimento L1 (remoto e presencial): diagnóstico inicial, execução de runbooks, orientação passo a passo e resolução dentro do escopo L1; quando aplicável, continuidade após camadas automáticas de orientação (L0,5), sem confundir distribuição (L0) com atendimento humano. Workplace e hardware de escritório: notebooks/desktops, periféricos, impressoras e suprimentos no contexto do hub, monitores e cabos, solicitações de equipamento no escopo acordado. Conectividade no workplace: telefonia (chips, ativações, políticas operacionais em coordenação com stakeholders), modem (triagem, troca, tickets). Grab apoio a compras operacionais de suprimentos/gadgets no escopo workplace. Descarte e eletrônicos: seguir processos de levantamento, descarte e conformidade quando previstos no hub. Onboarding no balcão: entrega de kits, orientação inicial e fluxo de Onboarding ligado ao kiosk/painel quando for o caso. Documentação e qualidade: uso de base de conhecimento, comentários no ticket que permitam métricas e auditoria; colaboração com melhoria de scripts, categorias e modelo de atendimento. Escalonamento: casos fora do escopo presencial/L1 imediato ou que exigem profundidade técnica: interface com L2/Eng (Pack 2), mantendo contexto e criticidade corretos no chamado. Indicadores e forma de trabalho (referência interna) Operação orientada a TMA, CSAT e SLAs de primeira resposta/atendimento; volumetria típica com forte componente L1 (remoto/presencial) e parcela de Office Tickets (hardware/ambiente físico), além de atividades de backoffice (estoque, logística, impressoras, telefonia, facilities correlatas, automações operacionais) que não aparecem só como ticket — o papel exige visão de fila + piso. Em hubs com cobertura acima do mínimo, o time pode rotacionar entre foco Tech Stop e foco fila L1 (modelo de dimensionamento/capacidade descrito no repositório). Requisitos Experiência sólida em service desk / L1 ou suporte presencial em ambiente corporativo. Inglês para leitura e conversação (desejável espanhol em operações multi-país; materiais de kiosk e fluxos costumam ser PT/EN/ES). Familiaridade com ITSM (Jira Service Management ou similar), identidade corporativa (ex.: Okta) e bom registro em chamado. Comunicação clara, postura de serviço e organização em ambiente de alta demanda. Capacidade de seguir runbooks, checklists e políticas de equipamento/DMP quando aplicável. Desejáveis Experiência com workplace: impressão (ex.: PaperCut em contexto hub), telefonia móvel corporativa, inventário/estoque. Conhecimento básico de rede/Wi‑Fi, SO corporativo (macOS conforme padrão da empresa) e troubleshooting de periféricos. Participação prévia em operação multi-hub ou fusos coordenados. O que valorizamos Accountability no ticket (triagem correta, menos reabertura). Colaboração com onboarding, facilities e engenharia na fronteira certa do problema. Melhoria contínua de processo, documentação e experiência no balcão. Regime De Contratação CLT Departamento Corporativo #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description: Overview Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together. Position summary – This position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, Peru. Over the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity; and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives. Responsibilities International Ocean Policy Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green-gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean-climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals. Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean-climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities. Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program. Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources. Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.g., side events, meetings with countries and partners). Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like-minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs. Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities. Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean-climate policy. As needed, facilitate in-person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives. Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs. Blue Climate Program Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed. Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects. Other duties as assigned by supervisor. Working Conditions Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required. Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions. This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process. Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones. Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high-level policy events. Qualifications Required Bachelor’s degree 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora. Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment. Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills. Excellent time management skills and ability to adapt in a fast-paced, changing environment. Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse, international team. Experience partnering with, and influencing, key stakeholders and building strong partnerships across public and private sectors and civil society. Excellent written and oral communication skills, and ability to effectively communicate complex information to a diverse audience. Enthusiasm and capacity for learning scientific and related basis for specific conservation outcomes as needed to support policy priorities and processes. Fluency in written and spoken English. Preferred Bi-lingual or multilingual in official UN languages. Expertise in coastal blue carbon and marine ecosystems, climate change science, and/or nature-based solutions Master's degree or other advanced degree in environmental policy or related field. Experience working globally in a range of cultural settings. To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter. See all Conservation International Career Opportunities HERE Conservation International is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We believe in hiring based on merit and qualifications, ensuring a fair and inclusive hiring process for everyone. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia. Qualifications Technical Diploma or Bachelor's degree in relevant fields, such as petroleum technology or mechanical engineering from a recognized and approved program. 10-15 years’ experience in rigless well intervention operations that includes planning and execution of stimulation, wireline, slickline, coiled tubing and flowback operation in critical sour gas and preferably unconventional operational environment. Experience in unconventional resources or HPHT, tight gas & oil well with a very good understanding of well intervention and stimulation operation and its impact on well completion. Proven record in running all types intervention operations required in unconventional wells: Coiled tubing, Wireline, slick line, Hydraulic fracturing, flow back operations. Familiar with wellhead and downhole completion design, optimization, and troubleshooting. Extensive knowledge of industry regulations, safety practices and standards related to surface and downhole equipment selection. Experience in optimization of surface well intervention operation using latest new technologies and best practices. Able to complete an investigation when issues occur and finalize root cause analysis. Experience in performance optimization, cost control, and operational efficiency improvements in unconventional well environments. Strong expertise in unconventional wells operation, well performance analysis. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Maintenance Engineer
description: Location :Rio de Janeiro ERP Eligibility :((cust_erp)) Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliver powerful solutions. We are currently seeking a skilled and dedicated Maintenance Engineer to join our Offshore Production Operating Division, based in Rio de Janeiro. This role is a critical part of our Onshore Operations Support team and plays a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and efficiency of offshore production assets. Key Responsibilities Develop, review, and implement maintenance plans, schedules, and procedures for offshore production equipment and systems to maximise operational availability. Perform technical analysis and troubleshooting to diagnose equipment failures and implement corrective actions promptly. Qualifications & Experience A Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Marine Engineering or a related technical discipline. Proven experience in maintenance engineering, preferably within the offshore oil and gas or marine production industries. Strong understanding of offshore production equipment, mechanical, electrical and instrumentation systems. Familiarity with maintenance management systems (CMMS) and relevant software tools. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver maintenance projects within agreed deadlines. Excellent problem-solving skills combined with strong communication abilities and teamwork orientation. Knowledge of international safety standards and regulatory requirements applicable to offshore operations. What We Offer Opportunity to work in a dynamic and supportive international offshore production environment. Engagement with cutting-edge technologies and innovative maintenance practices. Collaborative team culture focused on safety, inclusion, and professional development. Competitive remuneration package and benefits aligned with experience and qualifications. If you are passionate about maintenance engineering and committed to operational excellence in offshore production, we encourage you to join our team. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: BRAMU Medical Support Officer
description: Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international medical humanitarian organization that provides neutral, impartial, and independent healthcare to people affected by conflict, epidemics, natural disasters, or exclusion from access to healthcare in more than 70 countries. Aligned with the values that guide the actions of our organization around the world, MSF-Brazil is committed to promoting inclusion and diversity and understands the importance of affirmative action aimed at promoting equal opportunities. For this reason, seeking to provide ethnic‑racial equity, only applications from people who self‑declare black (brown or black) and who meet the established requirements will be accepted. BRAMU – Brazilian Medical Unit BRAMU is a medical unit that responds to the different MSF projects in the Latin American region through technical advice and strategic‑operational support. BRAMU professionals provide technical support as requested by the Operational Centers based on project needs. The main activities constitute the following: Technical and Operational Support to project teams, Provision of training, Development of institutional partnerships, and advocacy in the medical area. The growing challenges in the Latin American region around migration, violence, environmental crisis and other emerging health issues have made the unit move towards a comprehensive, interdisciplinary approach using applied social sciences, evidence‑based medicine, and epidemiology. BRAMU’s portfolio of services is targeted to the following topics: Migration, Urban violence, Environmental health, Adolescent Health, and Mental Health. The team comprises six experts: a Migration & Violence advisor, an Environmental Health advisor, an Adolescent Health advisor, an epidemiologist, a Health Promotion focal point, and a Psychosocial support focal point. OBJECTIVE To strengthen and develop the institutional medical work of MSF Brazil to enrich the connection of the Latin American reality with MSF operations worldwide through institutional representation and by connecting MSF with experts and innovative actors in the region. In addition, it offers transversal medical support to BRAMU activities in all the portfolio thematics. RESPONSIBILITIES MSF-Brazil institutional medical support: Contribute to enlarging and maintaining a regional institutional medical network and initiatives by participating in strategic meetings/conferences/events/workshops. Support Fundraising and Communications departments in activities requiring medical advice, such as information and communication strategies on medical topics. Validate medical content for articles, interviews, magazines, donor consultations on medical issues, etc. Support the Management Team of MSF-Brazil, in medical positions, reflections, and institutional representation when necessary. Lead the medical component of advocacy initiatives/activities. Work with the HR department and staff health focal point to develop and adapt staff health protocols, if needed. Participates in relevant national forums to disseminate/represent BRAMU/MSF-Brazil’s position on humanitarian medical issues. Contribute to reflection on medical and humanitarian dilemmas in the region through debates, analysis, and brainstorming exercises within MSF and with external partners. Act as point of contact for MSF-Brazil institutional issues in the absence of the BRAMU director. Collaborate with the MSF- Brazil association to develop a medical network, participating as a medical representative in the different association initiatives when relevant. Brazilian Medical Unit (BRAMU) activities Contribute to the Unit’s strategy and planning Provide transversal medical perspective to team activities Participates in the development of tools and resources related to the Unit’s topics Expand and maintain an academic network for research collaboration relevant to the Unit’s portfolio Participates in the development of operational research initiatives Follows up on events/conferences/webinars pertinent to the Unit’s portfolio Participates actively in the organization of the MSF medical conference Latam Scientific Days Ensures the medical and epidemiological monitoring of medical emergency dossiers in the region (COVID-19, infectious outbreaks, etc.), and alerts regularly about relevant humanitarian emerging issues Supports BRAMUs training regarding the medical component EDUCATION Medical degree Master’s/PhD in Public/International Health or equivalent professional experience A degree in Epidemiology is an asset EXPERIENCE Medical Humanitarian field projects (differential) Proven experience with research Advocacy, networking, communication LANGUAGES Fluent Portuguese or Spanish English (min. intermediate level) SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE Deep knowledge of the South American region Office Package – intermediate Public Health/International Health Epidemiology CORE COMPETENCIES Commitment to MSF principles. Service Orientation Planning and Organization Behavioral Flexibility SPECIFIC COMPETENCIES Contact and Relationship Network Building Group Work and Cooperation Strategic Vision Analytical Thinking #J-18808-Ljbffr

This company is a small but mighty international team with an even mightier goal: turn a strong SaaS product into a growth machine. Your role We're looking for a generalist who's comfortable across the stack – backend, data pipeline, background jobs, and the occasional frontend change. Experience building internal tooling and dashboards – revenue reports, payout summaries, cohort analyses, or similar business‑facing data products, ideally tied to financial or affiliate data. Async‑first, high‑ownership work style – comfortable communicating through written updates, making independent decisions, and taking full responsibility for features from build through monitoring. Practical experience using AI‑assisted development tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) as a regular part of the development workflow to increase output quality and speed. Nice to have Data or analytics engineering background – prior work with data pipelines, event tracking, affiliate/conversion data, or analytics engineering is a meaningful differentiator for this role. Familiarity with dbt (data build tool) for building and maintaining data transformation models, or a strong desire to learn it quickly in the context of analytics and reporting. Benefits For You Real impact: High‑impact ownership in a small team working closely with leadership – your work is visible, directly shapes growth. You influence decisions and priorities, not just execute tasks. Growth ownership: High autonomy over your domain, with the trust and resources to execute well. Flexibility: Remote‑first setup – work where and how you’re most effective. Growth support: Real room to grow, with a learning budget to improve execution. title: TECNICO DE LABORATORIO (COLETA) - HOSPITAL CARDOSO FONTES
description: Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS e responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes . OHospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro.A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia. Executar atividades técnicas de laboratórios, de acordo com as áreas específicas em conformidade com normas de qualidade de Biossegurança e controle do meio-ambiente. Manipular soluções químicas, reagentes, meios de cultura e outros. Curso Técnico de laboratório completo (Análises Clínicas, laboratoriais, bioquímicas ou patologia). Registro ativo no conselho da classe. Ensino médio completo. 6 meses de experiência na função. Local: Jacarepaguá/RJ Escala: 12 horas de trabalho X 60 horas de descanso - 30h semanais. Horário: 6:30 as 12:30 (Diarista ou plantonista) Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção. Step 3: Avaliação 3 Avaliação SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão. A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação. Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental. Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber. Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros. O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS. O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo. Inclusão A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades. Missão Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental. Visão Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Analytical and action‑oriented mindset, capable of translating field insights into clear, impactful actions. Highly organized, disciplined, and results‑driven, with strong attention to execution quality. Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools. Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus. Willingness to travel extensively within São Paulo state and work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends. trends across the Americas Identify anomalies, gaps, and inconsistencies in datasets and resolve or elevate as needed Support the production of quick market insights, commentary, and ad‑hoc analysis Work with large, complex datasets to extract trends and actionable insights Maintain and enhance datasets related to crude oil markets Contribute to data quality improvements and workflow enhancements Collaborate with Data, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams Support client queries, presentations, and product demonstrations where needed Respond to internal and external data requests in a timely manner Manage KPIs and OKRs, provide insights for improvement, and support product development Experience & Background Experience in crude oil or petroleum market analysis, with a strong understanding of trade flows, supply/demand balances, freight, and refining basics Understanding of Latin American crude markets, with knowledge of regional asset dynamics Proficiency in SQL and Excel Experience working with large or complex datasets Fluent in English, Spanish, and/or Portuguese (written and spoken) Python—highly regarded Familiarity with geospatial / vessel tracking data Experience engaging with clients or supporting commercial teams Experience contributing to product or data improvement initiatives Strong data validation and validation skill with ability to investigate and troubleshoot data issues Ability to seamlessly connect granular data points with broad global market context and vice versa Ownership of day‑to‑day work and accountability for output Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment Collaborative and team‑oriented Proactive in identifying issues and suggesting improvements Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Energy, or related field. Graduate degree is a plus but not required Kpler is committed to providing a fair, inclusive and diverse work‑environment. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global community. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives and are an equal opportunity employer. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Staff Software Engineer - Digital Experience Platform
description: Staff Software Engineer - Digital Experience Platform Staff Software Engineer – Digital Experience Platform (DXP) About Us Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and beyond — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building. We combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. The Digital Experience Platform (DXP) is Nubank’s AI-first platform ecosystem designed to radically compress our product development workflow from concept to production. Today, building “Magic App”-quality experiences in our Backend-Driven Content (BDC) stack takes ~49 working days and ~24 handoff-heavy steps — DXP exists to close this Creation Gap and Workflow Gap by making AI-native tooling the default way we design, build, and ship experiences. We are building four core products: DXP Studio (an AI-powered creation environment that turns Figma designs into production-ready BDC code), DXP Dictionary (the curated knowledge base that makes AI agents “Nu-aware”), DXP Spec Protocol (our vendor-agnostic abstraction layer), and DXP Workflow (an orchestration platform for hybrid human + AI agent teams across the product lifecycle). As a Staff Software Engineer – DXP , you will be the technical leader and multiplier for this initiative: shaping the architecture of an AI-native platform, driving critical decisions across the Figma-to-BDC pipeline and agent orchestration, and partnering closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership to prove value and scale the platform company-wide. We’re looking for someone genuinely addicted to AI — who obsessively explores new models, agent frameworks, and AI-powered tools, and can turn that passion into leverage for thousands of Nubank engineers. You’ll be responsible for Architect the DXP Studio pipeline: Design and lead the end-to-end architecture for the Figma → DXP Spec → BDC code generation flow, ensuring vendor-agnostic abstractions (DXP Spec Protocol), NuDS component fidelity, and production-ready output quality. Lead AI agent integration & orchestration: Define how AI agents (codegen, QA, design-mapping, etc.) are composed, executed, and supervised inside DXP; drive decisions on LLM provider abstraction, context-assembly strategies, MCP tool surfaces, and execution environments. Own the DXP Dictionary and knowledge architecture: Architect the knowledge base that turns generic AI into Nubank-aware agents — how NuDS specs, tokens, canonical patterns and domain knowledge are ingested, structured, and consumed by generation and validation pipelines. Drive cross-platform integration: Lead the technical integration model with NuDS (component catalog & tokens), BDC/Core (patterns & services), HPP (widget / homepage infrastructure), and App Excellence (observability & quality metrics), defining clear contracts that position DXP as an orchestrator on top of existing platforms. Establish quality-at-generation-time: Design automated quality enforcement for generated experiences — NuDS compliance, token correctness, accessibility rules, structural integrity, golden tests — so governance happens by default at generation time, not via manual post-hoc review. Set technical strategy and roadmap: Contribute to the 6–18 month technical strategy for DXP, translating strategic bets into executable plans, identifying architectural risks and trade-offs between POCs and long-term scalability. Multiply engineering excellence: Mentor engineers within DXP and partner teams (NuDS, BDC, Mobile Platform), lead design reviews and RFCs, and raise the bar for AI-augmented development practices across Nubank. We are looking for a person who has Must Have Genuine obsession with AI tools and workflows — deep, hands‑on, daily experience with LLMs, AI agents and modern AI‑powered dev tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, custom agents, MCP servers); you are the person who has tried new tools before others even ask about them. Strong software architecture skills , with experience designing multi‑component platform systems that integrate AI/LLM capabilities into production workflows. Deep understanding of design‑to‑code pipelines, design systems or component‑driven UI development , ideally bridging design tooling (e.g., Figma) and code generation. Practical experience with AI/LLM integration in software products : prompt engineering, agent orchestration, context management, RAG architectures and/or MCP tool development. Proven ability to lead cross‑functional technical initiatives involving multiple teams and stakeholders, driving alignment and delivery in ambiguous environments. Excellent communication skills , translating complex architectural decisions into clear narratives for Product, Design and senior leadership. Product‑minded mindset , balancing technical excellence with pragmatic delivery — comfortable proving value via POCs before scaling platform capabilities. Experience with Nubank’s stack or similar patterns : BDC (Backend‑Driven Content), and broader mobile/frontend ecosystems. Will be a Plus Experience with Flutter at the intersection of design systems and code generation. Hands‑on experience building or integrating AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Devin, Cursor) into team workflows. Familiarity with workflow orchestration platforms , agent farms or multi‑agent systems. Understanding of analytical architectures , experimentation platforms, feature flags and progressive rollout strategies for generated experiences. Prior experience productizing internal developer tools or platforms that serve large engineering orgs. Contributions to open‑source AI developer tools or active presence in the AI‑for‑developers community. Location for this opportunity This role can be based in one of the following hubs: For global, multi‑location roles like this, our benefits package is competitive in each country and generally includes: Competitive compensation and the opportunity of earning equity at Nu Health / Medical Insurance Life Insurance (and AD&D where applicable) Extended maternity and paternity leaves Nucleo – our learning platform of courses NuCare – our mental health and wellness assistance program Paid time off and local holidays Retirement / savings plans (e.g., 401(k), HSA/FSA in the US; country‑specific plans elsewhere) Work‑from‑home allowance Relocation assistance package, if applicable Details for each location will be shared during the process, aligned with local regulations and practices. If you want to define how an AI‑native bank designs and ships product experiences — turning agentic workflows, design systems and code generation into everyday tools for hundreds of teams — we’d love to hear from you. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Arrivals & Departures Manager
description: Arrivals & Departures Manager Department: Events & Entertainment Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. THE POSITION The Arrivals & Departures Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering all Arrivals & Departures operations for and during the tournament. This role ensures seamless, safe, and efficient transportation services for all FIFA client groups and spectators, guaranteeing operational readiness and flawless delivery on all airports used for the tournament. The position also liaises closely with the Airport Operators, Federal Government and Host City authorities. This role reports to the Senior Transport Manager and oversees key arrivals and departures sub‑projects, including international and inter‑city planning and operations, as well as aviation venue management. The Arrivals & Departures Manager collaborates closely with Airport Operators, Federal Government agencies, Host City authorities, the LFS Senior Transport Manager, the Transport Government Liaison & Integration Manager, and FIFA to define and implement an integrated concept of operations for Arrivals & Departures services. It is also the responsibility of this position to develop airport operational plans that provide essential support to both the Transport Functional Area and Event Services. The successful candidate is expected to be a proactive and resilient professional, capable of leading and managing a team while operating efficiently under pressure and delivering to strict timelines. Managing the area’s activities and resources within the approved budget is also a key component of the role. The Arrivals & Departures Manager must ensure strong integration with all other FWWC2027 functional areas present at the airport—including Workforce, Volunteers, Guest Operations & Protocol Etiquette, Team Services, and IT—to ensure alignment with established FIFA SLAs and the seamless delivery of airport operations. Key Responsibilities Designing and implementing a suitable A&D service model that covers all tournament airports, to service all FIFA constituent groups (Teams, Referees, FIFA officials, VIPs, Workforce, Dignitaries, Media, Broadcast, Commercial affiliates) at all official point‑of‑entry/exit sites, based on FIFA requirements and agreed service levels. Planning and implementing an Arrivals & Departures Plan for each FIFA constituent group based on FIFA requirements and service levels. Negotiating with the airport authorities and government agencies to ensure that all the structures and procedures of the airports are aligned to deliver the best operation on peak throughout the FWWC2027 operational period. Designing the concept of operations, the venue operating plan, and all relevant A&D policies and procedures. Integrating with other LFS Transport workstreams functions within Event Transport for airport pick‑ups and drop‑offs. Coordinating with meet‑and‑greet companies regarding VIP arrivals and departures services. Contributing to the slot allocation plan of the host‑city airports for the tournament period, ensuring priority for FWWC2027‑related aircraft movements (mainly PMA charter flights and FIFA VIP private jets). Ensuring successful integration of the FWWC2027 air traffic into the overall international airline schedule. Participating proactively in the Airport/Mobility Working Groups and ensuring, via close collaboration with HC transport, civil aviation and airport operators and authorities, that the air traffic matches airport and terminal capacities. Planning and developing the tournament time operational plan for the airport (airside and landside operations) in coordination with airport authorities and other FWWC2027 functional areas (Security, Logistics, Team Services, Guest Operations, Marketing, etc.). Ensuring integration of the airport operational plan with the airport transportation plan and its correlation with all other transport services and operations. Delivering the final operational plan and ensuring successful and smooth operations for all constituent groups. Implementing project management within A&D and airport management, identifying key milestones of international and inter‑city arrivals and departures / aviation and airport management sub‑projects. Identifying and addressing key risks of the international and inter‑city arrivals and departures / aviation and airport management sub‑projects. Preparing content (slides, handouts, etc.) and reports for the FWWC2027 related management meetings and working group meetings. Supporting recruiting and hiring of each host‑city A&D manager, assigning responsibilities, and managing the team from planning through delivery. Overall accountability for appropriate staffing levels and quality employees across all airports. Ensuring all airport staff are properly trained by developing and maintaining training materials and coordinating the delivery of operational workshops, briefings and role‑specific instructions. This HQ manager maintains consistent training standards across all host‑city airports. Providing regular reporting to the transport senior manager, FIFA counterparts, and other key stakeholders on coordination progress, issues, and decisions. Supporting test events, rehearsals, and operational readiness exercises. Overseeing the installation and readiness of signage, transport desk, wayfinding, etc. Maintaining constant live communication with transport command and control, providing real‑time updates on airport operations, incidents, delays, and emerging issues. Ensuring that all critical issues are escalated promptly, enabling rapid decision‑making and coordinated responses across all transport functions, government agencies and airport operators. This includes monitoring on‑ground conditions, reporting deviations from the plan, and implementing solutions to ensure smooth and uninterrupted service delivery. Your Profile Qualifications Education – Bachelor’s Degree in Transport, Logistics, Civil Engineering, Project Management, Event Management or a combination of education and experience relating to the position. Master’s Degree is an additional asset. Experience Minimum of ten (10) years of event arrivals and departures (airport operations) experience in international major events in at least three (3) world‑class sport/football events (e.g., FIFA World Cup, Olympic Games). Experience should include solid experience in multiple aspects of event transport operations and project management. Minimum of five (5) years of management experience in a similar role within an organising committee leading large teams to deliver a time‑critical project. Proven experience of successfully managing and delivering transport projects of a similar size and scale. Proven experience of managing airport operations projects of a similar size and scale. Experience working with public and private sector partners in a collaborative environment and ability to build strong partnerships. Skills Advanced knowledge of administration and management principles. Advanced knowledge of team leadership, business process management. Advanced communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills, the ability to influence others and manage relationships. Ability to design, implement and operate a transport system in the Brazilian event environment. Advanced knowledge of transportation technical operating processes and activities. Ability to motivate others toward a common goal and manage a multidisciplinary team through conflicting priorities and continuous change requests. Ability to work and communicate in a corporate and project‑focused organisation. Proven project management skills within a complex project. Language skills – English language fluency both written and spoken. Strong analytical and organisational skills. Proven solution‑orientated decision‑making skills. Ability to work under pressure to immutable deadlines. Requirements Right to work in Brazil. Bilingual – Portuguese and English. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr
